# Objective

Apply the agreed disposition of an external code review (2026-10-21): eight
full-agreement fixes, three partial fixes with adjusted designs, one addition
(duckdb dev extra), and two documented disagreements (sourmash/coverage are
Phase-2 by spec; retained fraction stays as a distinct, correctly named metric).

# Scope (agreed items)

1. Uncalibrated thresholds no longer automatically approve: comparisons carry
   `threshold_calibrated`; PASS on uncalibrated → REVIEW +
   `TECH_THRESHOLD_UNCALIBRATED` (spec §7 "configured or calibrated").
2. Output collision protection covers manifest, policy, and fastp inputs.
3. Phred+64 heuristic tightened to the classic signature (min ≥ 64 AND max ≥ 90);
   uniform high-quality Phred+33 (e.g. all `K`) accepted.
4. BAM metrics selected by profile: insert-size only for `paired_short`;
   `n_content` added for BAM.
5. BAM `SM` reconciliation (conflict ⇒ identity FAIL; mismatch vs manifest ⇒
   metadata REVIEW) + full-scan undefined-RG record counter.
6. Reservoir: no per-update sort; BAM candidates batched (~4096) — the old
   per-record update was the real BAM bottleneck (reviewer's micro-benchmark and
   our re-profile confirm).
7. Comparison stage: lazy pair generation, per-dataset prepared inputs computed
   once, per-group streaming into the staged Parquet writer.
8. CASAVA mate-number parsing with cross-file and within-header contradiction
   checks.
9. Strict policy validation: real booleans, finite max, known (metric, method),
   string-list selectors, overlapping-scope duplicate rejection (disjoint repeats
   allowed).
10. Optional fastp evidence → `NOT_ASSESSED` unless required;
    `merge_rate` preferred over `merge_retained_fraction`.
11. Missed Phase-1 metrics added: BAM clipping summaries; joint
    read-length × mean-quality summaries (sample-based).
12. `duckdb` added to dev extras (tests import it).

# Files to touch

`src/seqconsistency/{sampling,fastq,bam,comparison,policy,parquet_io,pipeline,metrics,distributions,models}.py`,
`policies/example-illustrative.yaml`, `tests/**`, `examples/make_examples.py`,
`README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, `benchmarks/results-2026-10-21.*` (re-measured),
`docs/**`.

# Verification

1. New regression test per fix (reviewer counterexamples included).
2. Full suite green; mypy/ruff clean.
3. BAM scan re-profiled; full benchmark re-run clean; README numbers corrected.
4. Examples regenerated — expected decisions under the corrected semantics.
